1Overview. (a) The targeted baseline, CAA, is extracted from ∼ 2,000 A/B pairs labeled sycophantic vs. honest. A role vector is taken off the shelf from a general persona library ( , ); its extraction uses no sycophancy labels. (b) Either vector is scaled by a coefficient α and added to the model’s activations at a single mid-stack layer; α is still tuned on a separate split of sycophancy data. (c) Averaged over three selected “critical” roles (Skeptic, Devil’s Advocate, Judge), role vectors achieve 68% (Gemma 2 27B) and 98% (Qwen 3 32B) of CAA’s reduction in the sycophancy logit (bars show - ⁢ Δ logit ).
